resources.string: Contacts sync
Keep Google contacts on this phone up to date. Device contacts and contacts belonging to other apps are kept separately.

Allow changes to contacts in this Google account to be uploaded, including new contacts and deletions. Existing Device contacts will not be uploaded. Names, numbers, email addresses, postal addresses, organizations, notes, birthdays, nicknames and websites are supported. Conflicting edits are kept for review.
